items:
Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita! This includes bikes, beach chairs, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!



Welcome to "A Point of View." This luxurious beach home is the perfect destination for your next family vacation! Loaded with amenities this home is sure to please! Enjoy unobstructed panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico on the BRAND NEW roof top deck! Experience stunning sunsets and sunrises over the Gulf, along with the best views in Seaside from the homes roof top deck and 4th floor observation room! With views this beautiful you may never want to come back down! All this and you are only minutes from the Thyme St. beach access and steps to enjoying all Seaside has to offer!



As you enter the first floor of the home, you will breeze into the efficiency apartment that was recently upgraded with all new appliances and furniture!! This room includes a full kitchen, full bath, Queen Sleeper Sofa, and King loft bed designed for children and teens. Kitchen includes plastic ware for your convenience and outdoor use at the pool.



Out back, your very own private pool (that can be heated) and *spa are awaiting you! Lounge around the pool and catch some sun, cook delicious meals on the BBQ and end the night gathered around the fire pit with friends and family! The backyard is the perfect private oasis!



As you take the stairs, (or elevator), up to the second level you will find three bedrooms and two baths. The first bedroom has two sets of adult length bunk beds and is connected by a Jack and Jill bathroom, to the second guest bedroom with a king sized bed! You will also find the master suite with a private bathroom, and its own access to a private balcony on this level!



As you move on to the third floor you will be taken with the spacious open concept floor plan. This level has a beautiful gourmet kitchen with granite counter tops and top of the line appliances. You will find that it is fully stocked with anything you may need for all of your cooking needs, including dinnerware for dining. There is seating for 8 (five chairs, plus a bench) at the dining room table and additional seating for four at the kitchen bar. Relax in comfort in this home living area; which includes a flat screen T.V. and a comfortable sectional sofa! There is a half bathroom off the kitchen for added convenience. The third floor of the home also features another guest bedroom with a queen-sized bed with a full bathroom.



Take the elevator up to the 4th level and enjoy the best "Point of View" from the homes Brand NEW roof top deck, and viewing room! These unobstructed panoramic views are sure to please! Just one stay at "A Point of View," and you and your family are sure to have found your annual vacation destination for years to come!



Sleeping Arrangements: (Sleeps 16)

-King Loft Bed

-Queen Sleeper Sofa



2nd Floor -

-Guest Bedroom with 2 Sets of Bunk Beds and Shared Bathroom

- Master Suite with King Bed, Private Balcony and a Private Bathroom



Third Floor-

Guest Bedroom with Queen Bed and Private Bathroom and Balcony Access

-Queen Sleeper Sofa



Fourth Floor-

-BRAND NEW roof top deck!

-Observation room



FEATURES & AMENITIES:

-Large private 12x24 HEATED POOL - (POOL HEAT available for additional fee of $25/per day March-Oct, $35/day Nov-Feb)

-Beautiful home only three lots from the Gulf of Mexico.

-Roof top deck

-Free WI-FI

-Large ELEVATOR that provides access to all four floors.

-Spectacular Gulf views from this four-story home overlooking Seaside/Seagrove Beach.

-*Spa requires pool heat to be turned on to be heated.

-Elegant Kitchens 1st and 3rd Floor, including Granite Counter Tops and High-End Appliances.

-Very close to beach-closer than 99% of homes in Seaside/ Seagrove/ Watercolor.

-Parking for 2 cars/SUV's (May accommodate up to 3 small cars)

-Walking distance to Seaside

-Walking distance to Beach (5 minute walk to beach/1 minute bike ride)



Starter Amenity Package:

All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING: Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



FAQ's:

Type of coffee pot: K cup or standard coffee pot

Parking spots: 2-3 vehicles, depending on size. (1 designated next to home, 1 in covered parking spot, 1 in front of home over parking pad.)

Distance to beach: 1 minute bike ride/5 minute walk

Bikes included: no (can use rental credit towards bikes.)

Beach Chairs & Umbrella set-up included: NO ( can use rental credit toward beach chair set-up)

Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
